Ships as a local-first MCP server with 23 tools. Your data n"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"ever leaves your machine."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> 🎬 **Live Demo**: 交互式演示页 · 源码 `docs/demo.html`"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why this is different"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Most memory systems store your data in the cloud, need a heavy dependency stack, or only do keyword
"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"search. **wanyimem is local-first, single-file SQLite, and installs with one dependency (numpy).**"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| | wanyimem | typical memory server |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Data | **never leaves your machine** (zero telemetry) | cloud / SaaS |
| Infra | **SQLite single f"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ile**, no separate vector DB | Qdrant / Neo4j / Postgres |
| Defaults | **shadows the agent**, block"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"s high-risk actions, opens counterfactual branches | stores & retrieves |
| Resources | **runs on 2-"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"core / 2GB** | heavier |
| Evolves | **zero-participation** (learns from your mistakes automatically"},{"id":"p8s5","text":") | manual "remember this" |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**23 MCP tools, open source (MIT), Python 3.10+, `pip install wanyimem`.**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"LLM agents forget. Every chat window is amnesia: preferences, lessons, and hard-won experience evapo"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"rate when the session ends."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"WanYi Memory Core is a **local-first, full-quantity, self-evolving memory system**:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Event sourcing** — an append-only WAL is the single source of truth. Nothing is ever deleted; de"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"cay only affects retrieval ranking.
- **Semantic recall** — hybrid retrieval: BM25 keywords + local "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"Chinese embedding (BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5) + reranker (BAAI/bge-reranker-base) + knowledge-graph exp"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ansion + explicit time decay. Vector search is **hybrid** itself: exact cosine below `ANN_MIN_COUNT`"},{"id":"p13s5","text":", and a `sqlite-vec` ANN pre-filter + exact re-rank above it — so it stays fast at scale without sac"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"rificing recall quality.
- **Metacognition** — when recall is weak, the system admits it and records"},{"id":"p13s7","text":" a knowledge-gap instead of hallucinating an answer.
- **Decision guardrails** — high-risk actions ("},{"id":"p13s8","text":"all-in, revenge-trading, force-push, rm -rf) trigger confidence-based blocking with counterfactual b"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"ranches: you see what would have happened *if you had listened*.
- **Zero-participation evolution** "},{"id":"p13s10","text":"— no need to say "remember this"; the system decides what to store, consolidates overnight, and surf"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"aces weekly trajectory reviews."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Requires Python 3.10+. Models (embedding ~95MB, reranker ~1.1GB) are downloaded on first use from Hu"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ggingFace; set `HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com` if you are in mainland China."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> Before the PyPI release lands, you can also install directly from GitHub (identical code):

[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## CLI & Automation"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Beyond the MCP server, wanyimem ships two console commands after `pip install wanyimem`:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"> `wanyi-export` renders the event-sourced store into a human-readable, version-controllable Markdow"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"n mirror (grouped by 道/法/术, plus mistakes / experiences / knowledge-gaps / counterfactual branches /"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" cross-domain patterns). `wanyi-auto` automates the guardrails: it honestly settles overdue counterf"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"actual branches (marking them `expired` rather than fabricating a winner), runs sleep + deep consoli"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"dation, and surfaces the cross-domain analog patterns most worth recalling."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Area | Capability |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Storage | SQLite + append-only event WAL; 道/法/术 three-layer half-lives |
| Retrieval | Keyword BM2"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"5 + vector (bge-small-zh) + reranker (bge-reranker-base) + graph expansion + time-decay fields |
| M"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"etacognition | knowledge-gap auto-record, `stats` self-check, honest "I don't know" |
| Guardrails |"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" confidence-based decision blocking, counterfactual branches with auto-settlement, cross-domain anal"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ogy bridging |
| Proactivity | daily brief on LOAD, due-branch reminders, weekly trajectory replay, "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"risk-keyword alert |
| Growth | mistake book, experience crystallization, overnight consolidation, e"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"volution queries |
| Privacy | fully local, zero telemetry, no cloud dependency |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Public benchmark (LongMemEval)** — session-level retrieval, full results in `benchmark/RESULTS.md`"},{"id":"p25s2","text":". Core (BM25 + graph, no models) reaches **Recall@5 = 0.960 / MRR = 0.907** on `s_cleaned` (with ~40"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" distractor sessions). Reproduce via `python benchmark/longmemeval_run.py`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Benchmark — reproducible mini LongMemEval (14 keyword-mismatched cross-session fact queries, run via"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" `python benchmark/recall_benchmark.py`):"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Version | Recall@5 | MRR |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Core (keyword BM25 + knowledge-graph, no models) | **1.000** (14/14) | **0.857** |
| Full (bge-sma"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ll-zh vector + bge-reranker-base rerank) | **1.000** (14/14) | **0.857** |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Every query is intentionally phrased with *different keywords* than its answer (e.g. `本地数据库怎么提高并发写` "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"→ `WAL模式`, `记忆系统最怕什么` → `事件溯源`), so 14/14 reflects genuine **semantic** recall, not string matching."},{"id":"p29s3","text":" The knowledge-graph channel (active in the core, model-free) already lifts BM25 to parity here; the"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" vector + reranker path shows its edge on larger-scale semantic expansion ("pip install wanyimem[all"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"]" downloads the models)."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Architecture (1.1.0)"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Standards-compliant stdio**: speaks MCP newline-delimited JSON and still parses legacy LSP `Cont"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ent-Length` frames.
- **Compat facade**: `wanyi.memory_core`, `python -m wanyi.memory_core`, `python"},{"id":"p32s3","text":" -m wanyi` and the `wanyi` console script all keep working after the 1.1.0 module split.
- **33 test"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"s** (pytest, py3.10–3.12 CI matrix + ruff): stdio protocol compliance, module-split integrity (symta"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"ble-based missing-global guard) and a full 23-tool smoke pass."}],"truncated":true}
